product.name: Velara AirClean Pro 3.5
product.description: The Velara AirClean Pro 3.5 is a compact in‑car air purifier designed to improve cabin air quality on the go. Its lightweight ABS housing measures 15 cm across, 8 cm deep and 10 cm tall, fitting easily behind the steering wheel or in the glove compartment. Powered by a 5 W USB‑C adapter, it draws minimal energy while running continuously. A built‑in HEPA filter captures fine dust, pollen and odors, and a charcoal‑gel layer neutralises unpleasant smells. The unit features a simple on/off switch, a quiet fan and a clear indicator LED. Ideal for daily commutes, long‑haul drives or any vehicle that needs fresher air.
